title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement — Holding and Opening Terms
content:
**Clause 1. Holding.** An employer holds at most 1 Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement. Additional pay schedules or legal entities of the employer are added as payroll groups on the same agreement, never as a second agreement. An employer may not hold a second agreement that is not terminated.

**Clause 2. Opening terms.** A new agreement opens in contracted status at the tier whose headcount band contains the employer's eligible headcount at signing, with the configured access percentage set to the tier's default access percentage unless the employer chose another permitted value, with nothing owed on either receivable (the deducted amounts owed under deduction schedules and the program charges owed), and with a renewal date the signed term in months after the signed date.

## Basis of the holding check

Whether the employer already holds an agreement is read from the company's own agreement records for that employer, not from the employer's statement. An agreement in contracted, implementing, live, suspended or terminating status is an agreement that is not terminated; each new agreement is a separate record with its own signed date.

| The employer's existing agreement record shows | A second agreement may be opened |
|---|---|
| no agreement | yes |
| an agreement in contracted, implementing, live, suspended or terminating status | no |
| only agreements in terminated status | yes |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

An employer with an eligible headcount of 320 at signing, signing a 24-month term on the 10th of a month, opens on the Paystride Program Professional tier in contracted status, with the access percentage at that tier's default unless it chose another permitted value, and with a renewal date on the 10th of the month 24 months later. A second payroll schedule it runs is added as a payroll group on that agreement.
